text:
maria-sales: Heads upLargeHealth wants a 5-day POC. They prefer no internet egress for inference. Asking options: PrivateLink only, VPC peering, or full on-prem appliance. Need a one-page network checklist + any gotchas for internal proxies/SNI rewriting. Can we put together?

kevin-net: kevin-net: Quick notes: PrivateLink = interface endpoints + ENIs in the customer's subnets, control-plane via TCP/443. VPC peering keeps traffic at L3 but requires route table changes both sides. Tradeoffs: PrivateLink simplifies DNS and IAM scoping; peering is lower-latency but needs cross-account routing approvals.

olivia-sec: olivia-sec: Security caveats: if customer has TLS-intercepting proxy, that will break mutual trust. Recommend they whitelist our cert SANs and disable SNI rewrite for those prefixes. Also ask for their DLP/RASP rules for payload scanning.

sam-sre: sam-sre: For a no-egress POC we have two feasible approaches:
- PrivateLink + customer-hosted S3 bucket (we assume role to pull model artifacts). No internet egress required if they give us internal S3 access.
- Temporary Dedicated nodegroup inside their VPC (enterprise add-on) — fully isolated, needs license and SRE runbook.
Which do they prefer?

maria-sales: Customer prefers minimal changes. They asked whether PrivateLink still needs outbound 443 to public IPs for things like telemetry or kernel downloads.

kevin-net: kevin-net: If we configure everything to use the interface endpoint and we pull artifacts from their S3, outbound public IP egress is not required. However, ephemeral health checks and some third-party package retrieval might need access; we can stub those out for POC. Also ensure their route table has entries for the ENI IP ranges.

olivia-sec: olivia-sec: Firewall checklist I usually give customers:
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to the PrivateLink ENI CIDR (we'll give the list in onboarding)
- Open UDP/TCP 53 to their DNS resolver
- Allow AWS API endpoints if using AWS-managed infra for role assumption (sts.amazonaws.com over 443)
- Optionally allow TCP 22 if they want to SSH into a bastion for troubleshooting
Also: provide us a customer IAM role for S3 read (arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-poc-s3-read).

sam-sre: sam-sre: Route examples to drop into theirs:
```
# route table entries (example)
10.200.10.0/24 -> eni-0a1b2c3d  # PrivateLink ENI block
10.200.0.0/16 -> pcx-0abc1234    # if peering used
```
Make more specific routes for service ENIs to override broader 0.0.0.0/0 defaults.

maria-sales: They also have an edge proxy that rewrites SNI to enforce corporate certs. Is there a workaround if they can't disable rewrite?

kevin-net: kevin-net: Workaround: deploy our Dedicated variant inside their VPC (no control-plane egress), or put the POC on an isolated subnet that bypasses the proxy (requires change control). Both are heavier.

olivia-sec: olivia-sec: For the security questionnaire, I will attach SOC2 summary, data retention policy, and KMS integration details. Also ask them to confirm whether traffic inspection is applied to host-to-host ENI traffic. If yes, recommend exception for our ENI CIDRs.

maria-sales: Can we give them a short allowlist snippet they can paste into firewall change ticket? They asked for a copy/paste.

sam-sre: sam-sre: Sure. Example allowlist lines (replace with actual CIDRs we provide):
```
# Redwood Private POC allowlist
TCP 443 10.200.10.0/24   # PrivateLink ENI block
TCP 443 52.14.36.58      # optional fixed endpoint IP (if provided)
TCP 443 sts.amazonaws.com # for role assumption
UDP/TCP 53 <onprem-dns-ip>
```
Add Route53 conditional forwarding to resolve privatelink hostnames into the VPC private zone.

maria-sales: Pricing question: they want an estimate for a 5-day POC (dev tier) and rough uplift for dedicated private deployment.

kevin-net: kevin-net: I'll loop in sales-ops for a POC line-item. Typical dedicated uplift is ~2x-3x depending on commit and instance type.

maria-sales: Can someone set a meeting with AWS/network ops and the customer tomorrow 9am PDT to walk the runbook?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket CTX-4521 and scheduled "POC network runbook" for 2024-04-18 09:00 PDT. Invites sent to maria-sales, kevin-net, sam-sre, olivia-sec.

maria-sales: Great, thanks. I'll send the customer the allowlist + short note about SNI passthrough and ask them to confirm if they can provide the S3 role. :thumbsup:
